en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a small alpine town nestled in a valley surrounded by densely forested mountains and snow-capped peaks. The settlement consists of traditional multi-story buildings and a prominent church with a tall steeple near the center. Foreground trees frame the scene. At the bottom right of the image, white caption text indicates the town name, its altitude, and the word 'Panorama.'
